name: @slayzone/terminal
//xterm: @xterm/* + @xterm/headless are pinned (exact, no ^) to the xterm 6.1 beta channel for ScreenDprMonitor + texture-atlas race fixes and the ESC[3J scroll fix. Move all 7 in lockstep: one xterm.js commit per set (npm `gitHead`). Re-bump when xterm 6.1 ships stable, or to a newer beta if a relevant fix lands.
//xterm-build-numbers: Lockstep is the source commit, not the beta number: each package counts its own builds. This set is xterm.js c58ea36 (2026-08-30): xterm beta.304, headless beta.303, the addons beta.301, addon-webgl beta.300. Every addon peers @xterm/xterm ^6.1.0-beta.304. Do NOT align the numbers — e.g. addon-webgl 0.20.0-beta.304 is a different commit.
//xterm-atlas-fix: Since beta.291/292 the build carries the shared-texture-atlas fix (xterm.js #6042 pageLayoutVersion + #6055). CharAtlasCache is module-level, so N terminals share ONE TextureAtlas; before this fix, clearTexture() set no invalidation flag, so our correctAtlas() repacked the shared atlas and left every SIBLING renderer painting stale texcoords (garbage glyphs over correct layout until a resize). Never re-pin below it — src/client/xterm-atlas-fix.test.ts guards the shipped bundle; src/client/xterm-ed3-scrollback.test.ts guards the ESC[3J fix (#6081).
